subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four exact-pin expectations are repaired, should these 14 privileged GitHub Action revisions be accepted as one grouped update or split into smaller trust-boundary batches?
rationale: The patch changes third-party executable code across secrets, publishing, security analysis, and agent workflows; automation can verify syntax and guards but cannot choose the acceptable supply-chain review boundary.

options.title: Repair and audit together
options.body: Update the four expectations, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the grouped batch only after reviewing each upstream release and SHA.

options.title: Split sensitive revisions
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker publishing, and security-scanning actions into smaller PRs when grouped source review is too broad.

recommendation.title: Repair and audit together
recommendation.body: Update the four expectations, rerun exact-head checks, and accept the grouped batch only after reviewing each upstream release and SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected workflow surfaces and live routing most strongly point to steipete for the final trust-boundary decision.
